FPNE40 NFFN 231800
NIUE

WEATHER BULLETIN ISSUED FROM NWFC NADI OCT 232040 UTC.
A STRONG WIND WARNING REMAINS IN FORCE FOR THE LAND AREAS OF NIUE. 

SITUATION:
A FRESH TO STRONG SOUTHEASTERLY WIND FLOW PREVAILS OVER NIUE.

FORECAST TO MIDNIGHT TOMORROW FOR NIUE:
EXPECT STRONG SOUTHEASTERLY WINDS WITH WIND SPEEDS UP TO 40KM/HR OVER
THE LAND AREAS.
ROUGH SEAS.

FINE APART FROM BRIEF SHOWERS. COOL AT NIGHT.

FURTHER OUTLOOK:    FINE APART FROM BRIEF SHOWERS. COOL AT NIGHT.
STRONG WINDS GRADUALLY EASING.
